name: Rocket Blast - 1g Cart - Rainbow Rips
description:
Sweet, fruity, and full of flavor. The Rocket Blast Rainbow Rips cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Rainbow Rips brings that classic candy-shop mix: juicy assorted fruit notes with a bright, tangy snap and a smooth, sugary finish. It's a fun, taste-forward profile made for anyone who likes their sessions sweet, colorful, and packed with flavor.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Rainbow Rips flavor — juicy mixed fruit with a tangy candy finish
Reliable performance — flavorful, even pulls from first to last

Big flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Rocket Blast Rainbow Rips is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
